turns.replyTail:
st now
Yes, you can cancel an order after placing it if it has not yet shipped. To do this, submit a cancellation request as soon as possible by emailing care@nurosym.com. If the cancellation is confirmed, the refund is issued to your original payment method. 
Once the order has been handed to the courier and is in transit, cancellation is no longer possible.
